title.value: Multivariate Time-Series Anomaly Detection with Contaminated Data
title.justification: The title accurately reflects the study's focus on developing an anomaly detection method for multivariate time-series data, particularly in scenarios where the training data is contaminated with anomalies.
title.quote: Multivariate Time-Series Anomaly Detection with Contaminated Data

extractions.description: The paper presents a novel approach to multivariate time-series anomaly detection (TSAD) in the presence of contaminated data, introducing an unsupervised method called TSAD-C. The approach encompasses three modules: a Decontaminator that corrects data abnormalities, a Long-range Variable Dependency Modeling module for capturing dependencies within the data, and an Anomaly Scoring module to identify anomalies. Extensive experiments demonstrate the model's state-of-the-art performance on physiological datasets.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on developing a method for multivariate time-series anomaly detection, which can be applied in various domains but does not specifically target Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development issues.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: The unusual patterns can be found in many real-world applications such as instances of financial fraud, abrupt temperature spikes or unforeseen precipitation in weather data, security breaches, system malfunctions, and irregularities in heart rate or brain activities.

primary_category.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on anomaly detection methods for multivariate time-series data rather than directly addressing Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development themes.
primary_category.quote: TSAD-C encompasses three modules: a Decontaminator to rectify the abnormalities (aka noise) present in the training data, a Long-range Variable Dependency Modeling module to capture both long-term intra- and inter-variable dependencies within the decontaminated data.

secondary_categories.justification: The paper does not have a secondary focus on Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development themes, as it centers on methodological advances in anomaly detection.
secondary_categories.quote: Our extensive experiments conducted on three reliable datasets conclusively demonstrate that our approach surpasses existing methodologies, thus establishing a new state-of-the-art performance in the field.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper does not explicitly align with any specific sub-category of Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development, as its main contribution is in the field of multivariate time-series anomaly detection.
primary_sub_category.quote: This paper presents a novel and practical end-to-end unsupervised TSAD when the training data are contaminated with anomalies.
